subject.title: Fix OpenClaw command tool runtime path

question: Should nix-openclaw intentionally replace the upstream inherited-HOME contract for managed Codex app-server launches and own `$CODEX_HOME/home/.nix-profile/bin`?
rationale: That choice changes credential and configuration discovery plus startup behavior for existing installations, so implementation proof cannot substitute for explicit maintainer intent.

options.title: Preserve upstream HOME
options.body: Route runtime tools through the supported command PATH configuration without rewriting HOME or owning persistent Codex profile state.

options.title: Adopt isolated HOME
options.body: Accept the behavior only with a migration, collision-safe startup semantics, and fresh-install plus upgrade proof.

recommendation.title: Preserve upstream HOME
recommendation.body: Route runtime tools through the supported command PATH configuration without rewriting HOME or owning persistent Codex profile state.

likelyOwner.reason: This maintainer owns the proposed runtime-path work and participated directly in its compatibility review.
